Resolves #20486

🌿 A stats read can no longer pass off the boot frame's drawing as the resized one.

`GraphScene#getStats()` now reports `owed`: a frame has been requested but not drawn. Until it draws, `frames` and `labels.drawn` still describe the last frame. The e2e helper `sizedSceneDrawn` waits until no frame is owed, so the labels it returns were drawn at the sized buffer. The first test's settle loop stays, and its comment now says what it guards.

Evidence: L2 (the failing CI trace, re-read; local off-socket e2e runs) → L2 required (a CI-only flake whose cause the trace shows). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/canvas/GraphScene.spec.mjs`, "a requested frame is owed until it runs": `false` before a request, `true` after `requestFrame()`, `false` once the frame runs |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/GraphScene.spec.mjs` `sizedSceneDrawn`: `!stats.owed` is in its predicate, and its JSDoc names the boot frame it skips |
| AC-3 | Local, off-socket tier with no Brain checkout: the full spec, 20 of 20 (4 tests × `--repeat-each=5`) |

## Deltas from ticket

- The ticket first deleted the first test's settle loop. Without it, 1 of 3 local runs failed: after the read with no frame owed (`frames 2`), a third frame landed in the idle second with nothing changed. Boot can still reach the renderer after its first sized frame, and `owed` cannot see a message still in transit. The loop stays, and the ticket records why (The Fix, item 3; that AC is struck).

## Test Evidence

- Root cause, from the failing shard's trace (run 42285892908, shard 7): the only stats read showed `frames 1`, the buffer at `[2000, 1288]`, 20 labels counted and uploaded, and 0 drawn.
- Local: `env -u NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN -u NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT NEO_NL_PORT=<free> npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/rendering/GraphScene.spec.mjs --repeat-each=5` gave 20 of 20 (4 tests × `--repeat-each=5`).
- agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

size-guard-growth: src/canvas/GraphScene.mjs — one code line (1047 → 1048): getStats() exposes the frame `animationId` already tracks as owed; no state is added, and only the engine knows it

- [ ] The next e2e-engine runs carrying this spec show no `GraphScene.spec.mjs` labels-drawn failure.
